<STRUCT_0001>
Let <MATH_0001> be a category. The <MATH_0002>-category of categories
fibred in groupoids over <MATH_0003> is a
``full'' sub <MATH_0004>-category of the <MATH_0005>-category of categories over
<MATH_0006> (see
Definition <REF_0001>).
Hence if <MATH_0007>, <MATH_0008> are fibred in groupoids
over <MATH_0009> then
<MATH_0010>
denotes the category of <MATH_0011>-morphisms in this <MATH_0012>-category
(see Definition <REF_0002>).
These are all groupoids, see remarks following
Definition <REF_0003>.
Here is the <MATH_0013>-category analogue of the Yoneda lemma.
